note: The adverb of *bon*: *Il parle bien.* *Bien sûr !* = Of course!
The comparative of *bien*: *Ça va mieux.* = I'm feeling better.
*-ment* is added to the feminine: *lente → lentement*.
After a vowel, *-ment* goes on the masculine: *vrai → vraiment*.
In speech *ne … que*: *Je n'ai que dix euros.* = I only have ten euros.
Also *well…*, to correct yourself: *Enfin, je crois.*
